content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request a few adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause on liability, my liability is currently unlimited while your liability is capped. I propose that each party's total aggregate liability arising out of or related to the agreement shall be limited to the total fees paid or payable by the client under the agreement. - Regarding the payment terms, the agreement currently makes payment conditional on receiving funds from a third party, which could delay payment indefinitely. I propose that invoices are payable within 30 days of receipt. Thank you for your time, and please let me know if these updates are acceptable.
